item.title: 'He was a light': Ghost bike memorial honors 6-year-old killed in Pacific Beach hit-and-run
item.description: A ghost bike has been placed at the site of a crash that killed 6-year-old Hudson O'Loughlin, in honor of his life and to call for safer roads.

item.title: Supreme Court refuses to block California's Democratic-friendly map
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday cleared the way for California to use its new congressional map that adds up to five Democratic-leaning seats for the midterms, rejecting Republicans’ emergency bid to block it. Supported by the Trump administration, the California GOP has challenged the map as an unconstitutional racial gerrymander. item.title: Cuts loom as San Diego faces a $110 million budget gap
item.description: The city is halfway through its fiscal year, and is currently facing around a $9 million dollar budget gap.

item.title: Residents upset over unfinished work, abandoned debris in San Diego neighborhood
item.description: Residents of Egger Highlands in South San Diego are frustrated by a utility project that has caused property damage and left debris and seemingly abandoned equipment.

item.title: PHOTO: Ferrari driver crashes into tree in Rancho Santa Fe
item.description: A driver was hospitalized in critical condition after crashing a Ferrari into a tree in Rancho Santa Fe while traveling at a high rate of speed.

item.title: 'Please reach out': Savannah Guthrie, family address purported captor in heartfelt Instagram plea
item.description: "Today" show co-host Savannah Guthrie and her two siblings posted a video Wednesday on Instagram directly addressing whomever might have their mother, and pleading for her safe return.

item.title: San Diego Police arrest 4 after busting illegal gambling den in City Heights
item.description: San Diego police have arrested four people and seized nine gambling machines, $625 in cash, and a semi-automatic handgun after breaking up an illegal gambling den in City Heights.

item.title: Chula Vista ranks 5th in U.S. cities for highest marriage rates
item.description: Chula Vista, California ranked 5th in the U.S. for highest marriage rate, with 50.2% of the population married, while Detroit, Michigan ranked 1st for highest number of single people, with 57.4% of residents never having been married.

item.title: Mark Wahlberg visits San Diego for opening of new restaurant Flecha Cantina
item.description: Actor and New England Patriots superfan Mark Wahlberg opened his third location of Flecha Cantina in San Diego, which offers a modern twist on traditional Mexican cuisine and celebrates Latino culture.
